data.job_title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer II arbeitnow SumUp Berlin, Berlin, Germany · 10/28/2026
data.job_description:
Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.

As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI.

What you'll do

• Design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability.

• Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency.

• Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving.

• Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability.

• Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation.

• Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning solutions into software applications and platforms.

You'll be great for this position if you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science or an engineering-related field.

• 4+ years of proven experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on building and deploying scalable machine learning or AI solutions and data-driven systems.

• Relevant experience building AI products, such as Chatbot Assistant, RAG system, etc.

• Solid Software development engineering skills to design computationally effective solutions and maintain them in large-scale production environments (data version control, model serving, continuous monitoring & alerting)

• Experience building and deploying ML models using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Expert in Python and familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Langfuse).

• Experience with machine learning workflow orchestration and algorithm optimisation, feature engineering pipelines, data ingestion and transformation.

Why you should join SumUp:

Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp.

Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team.

Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches.

About us:

SumUp is a leading financial technology company, founded in 2012 with the goal of empowering small businesses around the globe. We're the financial partner of choice for more than 4 million merchants in over 35 markets. We collectively build, plan and fine-tune the technology that drives SumUp and empowers small businesses around the world.

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their business. With a founders mentality and a 'team-first attitude' our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

This overview was written from the original listing to help you understand the role. Always confirm the specifics on the employer's application page.

Als Machine Learning-Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du Machine-Learning-Funktionen für unsere Produkte, Schritt für Schritt an konkreten Vorhaben. MICOS entwickelt ERP-Software für die Sozialwirtschaft. Im Innovationsteam prüfst du gemeinsam mit uns früh, welche Ideen tragen.

Deine Mission:
•
Entwicklung von Machine-Learning-Modellen und Integration dieser als Software in unsere Produkte, die Anwender nutzen.
•
Sicherstellung von wartbarem, getestetem Code unter Einhaltung unserer Softwareentwicklungsstandards.
•
Frühzeitige Einbindung in Innovationsvorhaben mit Datenpotenzial, um vorhandene Daten zu prüfen, die Eignung des Problems für Machine Learning zu bewerten und datenbezogene Annahmen zu formulieren.
•
Überprüfung dieser Annahmen anhand von Stichproben, einfachen Baselines und Machbarkeitstests sowie eine ehrliche Einschätzung, wenn diese nicht tragen.
•
Aufbereitung von Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen sowie Dokumentation ihrer Bedeutung.
•
Enge Abstimmung mit unserer Architektur, damit Modelle sauber in unsere Produkte integriert werden können.
•
Produktionsreife von Modellen durch Tests, Monitoring und Dokumentation sowie gemeinsamer Rollout mit unserer Softwareentwicklung in den Betrieb.
•
Datenschutzkonforme Umsetzung und frühzeitige Abstimmung mit Datenschutz und Security.

Das bringst du mit:

Du bringst Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit und hast Freude daran, sauberen, wartbaren Code zu schreiben. Zudem hast du Erfahrung darin, Machine-Learning-Modelle in einem Unternehmen produktiv zu bringen. Darüber hinaus bringst du Folgendes mit:
•
Data-Science-Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in statistischer Modellierung und Machine Learning und die Gewohnheit, Modelle gegen einfache Baselines zu validieren
•
Freude an Datenaufbereitung und daran, Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen zu verstehen
•
Kommunikationsstärke im Austausch mit Fach- und Technikrollen
•
Die Fähigkeit, Modelle und ihre Grenzen verständlich zu erklären und zu dokumentieren
•
Grundverständnis von Datenschutz (DSGVO)
•
Lust darauf, früh Ergebnisse zu zeigen und Annahmen zu prüfen, statt lange im Verborgenen zu optimieren

Was dich erwartet:
•
Arbeit in kurzen Zyklen: Im Innovationsteam prüfen wir Annahmen früh und passen Ideen an, wenn die Ergebnisse es verlangen.
•
Ein interdisziplinäres Innovationsteam, in dem du als Entwickler:in arbeitest, und feste Partner in Softwareentwicklung, Architektur und Security. Fachlich unterstützen dich Kolleg:innen, die unsere Kunden und Produkte gut kennen.
•
Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Ergebnisse direkt in Produkte zu bringen.

Warum wir?

Wir entwickeln digitale Lösungen für die Sozialwirtschaft. Im Innovationsteam erkunden wir, was in der Sozialwirtschaft möglich ist. Bei uns kannst du innovative Ideen zu realen Lösungen werden lassen, die Menschen und Organisationen stärken, die unsere Gesellschaft tragen. Als Softwareentwickler:in mit Data-Science-Expertise machst du aus Daten Funktionen, die in unseren Produkten Wirkung entfalten. Dafür bieten wir dir Gestaltungsspielraum, Vertrauen und ein motiviertes Team, das Innovation lebt. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Remote-Optionen und ein offenes Miteinander gehören dabei für uns zum Alltag.

About AgentixLake
AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.
Your role
Build AI application components that are ready to be tested, deployed and maintained. You will take ownership of defined engineering work within our generative AI projects, collaborating with colleagues on implementation, review and operational quality.
Our team builds enterprise AI solutions that connect models with useful data and tools. Your work may contribute to document intelligence, knowledge assistants, governed analytics or AI agents that support engineering and operational workflows.
What you will do
Develop Python services and integrations connecting language models to enterprise data, APIs and tools.
Implement document ingestion, chunking, embeddings and retrieval, with source references that users can inspect.
Build structured extraction and validation workflows for complex documents and downstream business systems.
Implement defined agent steps, including tool calls, permission checks, error handling and human approval.
Maintain evaluation cases and compare retrieval quality, answer usefulness, latency and cost as the application changes.
Contribute automated tests, deployment configuration, logging and documentation through reviewed pull requests.
What you bring
Current university enrolment in computer science, AI, data science or a related technical discipline.
Strong practical Python skills and evidence of software you have delivered for actual users, including responsibility for testing and deployment.
Hands-on experience with an LLM application involving retrieval, tool use or structured outputs, and the ability to explain its limitations.
Comfort working with APIs, JSON, Git and code review, and taking a defined task from an agreed requirement to a maintainable implementation.
Clear English communication and an evidence-based approach to debugging and evaluating system behaviour.

You will contribute to real delivery work with direct access to experienced engineers and the founders. Expect clear ownership, thoughtful code review and a part-time scope planned around your studies.

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Why This Role

AVIV Group runs some of Europe's best-known real estate platforms, and every one of them depends on trust: people need to find a home or a tenant, not a scam or a dead listing. Trust & Safety exists to protect that experience, and our north star is the share of leads that flow from good visitors to good listings. We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to build the systems behind it, from identity risk scoring to fraud-ring detection and listing integrity. This is an opportunity to build and improve, not simply maintain: the ML platform is still taking shape, so you will help define the ground you stand on.

The Team You'll Join

You’ll join our Trust & Safety team, a group of around twenty people made up of data and backend engineers, data scientists and analysts, product managers and engineering managers. You’ll work across immowelt, SeLoger and Immoweb and partner closely with Product, Policy and our human moderation operations.

Our next chapter is about building ML-driven detection that replaces static rules, and turning integrity and reputation scores into inputs for search ranking and recommendations. This role will be central to making that happen.

What You’ll Own

• Models across the trust stack: Design, train and ship identity risk scoring, fraud and fraud-ring detection, listing integrity scoring, duplicate and republication detection, and behavioral signals on both sides of the marketplace.

• Adversarial resilience and error balance: Build models and retraining loops that hold up as bad actors adapt, catch bad listings before they are reported, and treat false positives as seriously as false negatives, because a false positive is an honest owner who can’t publish their home.

• Evaluation you can trust: Run careful experiments that account for adversarial drift and feedback loops, where enforcement changes tomorrow’s training data, and give an honest analysis when offline and online results disagree.

• The human moderation loop: Connect reviewer decisions to model training and route uncertain cases to reviewers, integrating with moderation tooling such as Implio and measuring the whole loop.

• Signals other teams build on: Ship integrity and reputation scores that are planned inputs to search ranking and recommendations.

• Production and foundations: Own serving, monitoring, SLOs and a share of on-call for what you ship, build the pipelines and evaluation setup the team needs while the group ML/AI platform matures, and strengthen the team through design reviews, mentorship and writing that makes good decisions repeatable.

What We’ll Achieve Together

Success in this role means creating measurable improvements, not simply shipping more models.

We Expect You To Help Us

• Increase the share of leads flowing from good visitors to good listings.

• Raise the share of bad listings caught before they are reported.

• Reduce false positives.

• Reduce the share of bad experiences users encounter year over year.

The exact measures will be agreed based on the priorities and baseline when you join.

What You Bring

We care more about what you have built and improved than a particular title or number of years of experience. The level we hire at, Senior or Staff, depends on your experience and the scope you’re ready to take on.

You Bring

• Experience shipping at least 3 ML systems to production at meaningful scale, typically with around 6+ years of engineering experience for Senior and 8+ for Staff.

• Hands‑on experience in an adversarial or integrity domain such as fraud detection, anti‑abuse, spam, content moderation, risk scoring or account security.

• A solid grounding in imbalanced, high‑stakes classification: precision/recall trade‑offs with real cost on both sides, threshold and policy design, and calibration.

• Experience evaluating models in feedback‑loop systems, understanding how enforcement actions distort future training data and having worked around it in practice.

• Strong engineering fundamentals: production‑quality code, reliable data pipelines and reproducible work.

• Technical influence beyond your own output, plus clear communication about uncertainty with engineers, policy and operations partners, and leadership, including when the honest answer is "we don't know yet."

Nice to have:

graph-based detection (fraud rings, identity graphs, device and payment linkage); LLM-based approaches to trust work (content understanding for moderation, scam‑pattern detection, LLM‑assisted review); experience alongside human review operations (uncertainty‑based routing, active learning from moderation queues); a marketplace or classifieds background; familiarity with EU platform regulation such as the DSA.

How We Work at AVIV

Our Leadership Behaviours describe not only what we expect people to deliver, but how we expect them to deliver it.

For This Role, Four Behaviours Will Be Particularly Important

All Starts With Me.

You own what you ship end to end, including serving, monitoring and on‑call, and when a model isn’t holding up in production you understand why and drive it to resolution.

Data Leads. Judgment Wins.

You distinguish real signal from offline‑metric comfort, are honest when offline and online results disagree, and combine data with judgment on thresholds and policy.

Live for the Customer.

You remember that a false positive is an honest owner who can’t publish their home, and that a missed scam is a home seeker at risk, and you design with both people in mind.

Simplify to Scale.

You build pipelines, evaluation setups and signals that other teams can adopt, rather than one‑off fixes.

What to Expect From the Hiring Process

We want our hiring process to be focused, transparent and respectful of your time. You can typically expect 3 interviews with the people you would work most closely with. Depending on the role, we may also include a technical assessment relevant to the work you would be doing, such as a coding or system design session. We’ll explain the process from the start and keep you informed throughout.

About AVIV Group

Join one of the world’s largest and most innovative digital real estate tech companies. Backed by global investment leaders KKR and CPP Investments, AVIV Group is reshaping the way people across Europe buy, sell, rent, lease, and value real estate. With a strong presence in Europe, we power some of the region’s most recognized digital real estate platforms across various countries – including Immoweb, SeLoger, and Meilleurs Agents (France’s leading real estate valuation platform), alongside immowelt and Homeday (one of Germany’s fastest‑growing PropTech companies). Our European footprint is complemented by our dynamic tech and engineering hubs in Romania and Croatia. Our mission? We simplify life’s most important transactions. By combining data, technology, and human expertise, we empower millions of people to find their perfect home! Help us shape the future of real estate.

data.job_title: AI for Science Residency Computational Chemistry
data.job_description:
Overview

Microsoft Research AI for Science is seeking a postdoctoral researcher in computational chemistry to help generate the data behind Skala our deep-learning exchange-correlation functional for DFT.
You will join a collaborative team of quantum chemists and machine-learning researchers working on data generation for Skala including the generation of diverse chemical structures. You will work closely with colleagues across data generation model development and deployment and you will have access to substantial computational resources. Where possible results are shared through publications and open-source releases.
• Contract Length: 2 Years
• Contract Type: Residency
• Role Locations: Berlin Germany Cambridge UK and Amsterdam Netherlands

Responsibilities

• Design implement and scale methods for generating chemically diverse molecular structures. These include covalent and non-covalent structures (complexes conformers) bond-dissociation paths and reaction geometries/transition states.
• Combine and extend structure-generation approaches such as graph-based and fragment-based construction conformer and reaction-path sampling and molecular dynamics/metadynamics-based exploration. Use fast approximate methods (e.g. tight-binding) to explore and screen candidate structures.
• Define sampling and selection strategies so that new data fills gaps in chemical space and quantify how new structures overlap with existing datasets.
• Build and maintain robust automated reproducible data-generation workflows in Python on shared codebases working with the team members who run the high-accuracy wavefunction calculations at scale.
• Work with data-generation deployment and model-development colleagues to turn evidence from Skala training and benchmarking into priorities for the next datasets.
• Contribute to the efficiency of the data-generation pipeline including GPU-accelerated electronic-structure methods where they bring speed-ups.
• Prepare technical papers presentations and open-source releases of research code and data.

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:
• PhD in computational chemistry theoretical chemistry computational condensed-matter physics or a related area completed or close to completion (thesis submitted or expected within 6 months of the start date) or comparable research experience.
• Hands-on research experience with electronic-structure methods (DFT and/or semiempirical/tight-binding methods) and with generating optimising or sampling molecular structures.
• Proficiency in Python and experience with collaborative code development on shared codebases.
• At least one peer-reviewed publication or preprint in computational chemistry or a related field.
Preferred/Additional Qualifications:
• Experience developing or contributing to open-source scientific software for example quantum-chemistry or atomistic-simulation packages.
• Experience with extended tight-binding (xTB/GFN) methods and with conformer reaction-path or molecular-dynamics-based structure exploration.
• Experience building computational-chemistry datasets for example for training machine-learning models.
• Experience with GPU-accelerated or high-performance computing for quantum chemistry.
• Familiarity with wavefunction-based methods (e.g. coupled cluster) and thermochemistry or reaction-energy benchmarks.
• Experience integrating methods into existing quantum-chemistry codes (e.g. ORCA PySCF CP2K)

Picture this: Kids knock out a full day’s academics in just two laser-focused hours, then launch podcasts, paint murals, or perfect their back-handsprings all afternoon. That’s the 2-Hour Learning engine that powers Alpha Anywhere—and you’re the Learning Specialist who keeps it humming while revolutionizing it for the future.
Working from any Wi-Fi-friendly corner of the planet, you’ll transform tidal waves of AI-generated performance data into exact, timely interventions that push every learner toward 90% mastery and beyond. When a student hits a snag, you’ll jump on a live coaching call, dissolve the blocker in real time, and send them back into their flow with fresh confidence. Simultaneously, you’ll dive deep into rich streams of student performance data, uncovering hidden patterns that unlock children’s full potential, designing next-generation AI solutions that could double learning speed.
Parents witness soaring self-belief, students double their learning speed, and you see the direct impact of every insight you craft, every AI workflow you automate, and every question you ask. Ready to turn data into rocket fuel for young minds? Keep reading.
What You Will Be Doing
• Building laser-accurate Academic Data Reports and conducting systematic analysis to surface issues, flag anomalies, and trigger fixes within 48 hours
• Hosting rapid-response "rescue" calls and running post-assessment coaching sessions to resolve blockers, separate knowledge gaps from errors, and keep kids motivated
• Evaluating and implementing new educational apps and content while designing AI/LLM prototypes to innovate learning strategies and solve specific challenges
• Syncing with leadership to refine tools, dashboards, and mastery thresholds as the AI tutor evolves
What You Won’t Be Doing
• Sitting through endless meetings or handing off generic slide decks with no line of sight to real outcomes
• Grading papers, writing lesson plans, or managing traditional educational programs—the AI and innovation drive our work
• Operating in high-level strategy without implementation or getting stuck in routine tasks—this role is hands-on and dynamic
Learning Specialist Key Responsibilities
Drive improved student learning outcomes through AI-driven analysis and real-time academic insights, demonstrated by enhanced metrics like 2× learning velocity, app engagement, lesson comprehension, response accuracy, and reduced negative learning patterns across the Alpha Anywhere network.
Basic Requirements
• At least 1 year in a role involving coaching, training, or instruction
• At least 1 year directly and repeatedly supporting K-8 students through recurring one-to-one or small-group academic coaching focused on learning habits, motivation, self-direction, test behavior, or executive-function routines; whole-class teaching alone is not sufficient
• At least 1 year in a role that combined hands-on data analysis with direct student or learner support
• At least 1 year using Google Sheets or Excel for data analysis, including lookups, filters, pivot tables, charts, or similar functions
• At least 6 months using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot in professional workflows to produce real work outcomes, not only casual search or writing polish
• Available for support calls for any combination of hours totaling 6 hours each day, Monday through Friday, between 6:00 AM and 2:00 PM U.S. Central Time
Nice-to-have Requirements
• Background in learning science, educational principles, or demonstrated success improving outcomes through data-driven strategies
• Experience with Generative AI, prompting techniques, and basic coding skills (Python, JavaScript, etc.) for querying AI APIs
About 2 Hour Learning
Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.
They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.
